scripts.dev:web: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm run dev -w packages/web
scripts.dev:studio: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm run dev -w packages/studio
scripts.build:web: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.build:studio: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm run build -w packages/studio
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:studio
scripts.sync:notion: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm run sync:notion -w packages/studio
scripts.sync:notion:dry: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs npm run sync:notion -w packages/studio -- --dry
